title: Lean LFM-to-Dirac Derivation
description: Noncanonical Lean 4 research derivation through DIRAC-030. Starting from one positive two-field C19 action, the artifact derives a massive C19 Klein-Gordon tangent, a cubical four-component free-Dirac continuum square root, density/current, copy, spin, transport, rest-clock, zitterbewegung, phase-harmony and velocity identities. DIRAC-026--030 additionally derive free Lorentz boosts, the Pauli--Lubanski spin-one-half invariant, the infinitesimal Wigner--Thomas half factor, free charge conjugation and the Gordon current decomposition without changing the native action. Exact finite-spacing Lorentz symmetry, a localized nonlinear physical electron, electric charge, interacting antiparticles, electromagnetic coupling, magnetic moment, g factor and SI calibration remain open.
